name: Automated Collection
summary: Adversaries may automate collection of industrial environment information using tools or scripts. This automated collection may leverage native control protocols and tools available in the control systems environment. For example, the OPC protocol may be used to enumerate and gather information. Access to a system or interface with these native protocols may allow collection and enumeration of other attached, communicating servers and devices.

analytics.name: Analytic 1867
analytics.guidance: Real-time network monitoring identifies a source issuing systematic, sequential Industrial Control System (ICS) protocol reads sweeping the full register/address range across multiple field devices within a short time window, from a source not in the approved control server list. OT operational-fidelity gate: Do not alert on novelty, scan/read volume, or enumeration alone. Alert when the source role is not authorized for discovery/polling and the target scope, address/tag range, protocol, or rate deviates from the established operational baseline. Suppress normal SCADA/HMI/historian polling, commissioning, asset inventory, backup, diagnostics, and approved engineering activity.

analytics.name: Analytic 2128
analytics.guidance: Real-time monitoring identifies a scripting interpreter process iterating through Industrial Control System (ICS) data sources and writing output to a local file or piping to a network socket, by a User Identifier (UID) not associated with documented automation scripts. OT operational-fidelity gate: Do not alert on novelty, scan/read volume, or enumeration alone. Alert when the source role is not authorized for discovery/polling and the target scope, address/tag range, protocol, or rate deviates from the established operational baseline. Suppress normal SCADA/HMI/historian polling, commissioning, asset inventory, backup, diagnostics, and approved engineering activity.

analytics.name: Analytic 2270
analytics.guidance: Real-time monitoring identifies a host process making sequential Industrial Control System (ICS) protocol reads with output piped to a local staging file, from a process not associated with a recognized Human-Machine Interface (HMI) or historian tool. OT operational-fidelity gate: Do not alert on novelty, scan/read volume, or enumeration alone. Alert when the source role is not authorized for discovery/polling and the target scope, address/tag range, protocol, or rate deviates from the established operational baseline. Suppress normal SCADA/HMI/historian polling, commissioning, asset inventory, backup, diagnostics, and approved engineering activity.
